evidence.quote: Nvidia is in talks to provide a $250 billion backstop that would allow OpenAI to lease an Ohio data center, according to the Wall Street Journal.
evidence.one_line: 《华尔街日报》报道称，Nvidia正在谈判提供2500亿美元担保，以使OpenAI能够租赁俄亥俄州数据中心。
evidence.speaker: Hannah Pedone / MarketWatch

evidence.quote: The Ohio facility could cost over $500 billion and would be the largest data-center project announced to date, according to the Journal.
evidence.one_line: 《华尔街日报》称，俄亥俄州设施可能耗资超过5000亿美元，并将成为迄今宣布的最大数据中心项目。
evidence.speaker: Hannah Pedone / MarketWatch

evidence.quote: Nvidia and OpenAI did not respond to requests for comment.
evidence.one_line: 报道刊发时，Nvidia和OpenAI均未回应置评请求。
evidence.speaker: Hannah Pedone / MarketWatch

evidence.quote: "I don't know all the details or even how real this is, but if it does happen, I think it's hard to justify for Nvidia," he said.
evidence.one_line: Seaport Research的Jay Goldberg表示，他不了解安排细节，也不确定其真实性，但认为若安排落地，对Nvidia而言难以辩护。
evidence.speaker: Jay Goldberg / Seaport Research

evidence.quote: Goldberg noted that companies have previously "tripped themselves up with financing customer purchases."
evidence.one_line: Goldberg指出，公司过去曾因融资客户采购而陷入困境。
evidence.speaker: Jay Goldberg / Seaport Research

evidence.quote: "These kinds of financing usually don't end well," Goldberg added.
evidence.one_line: Goldberg补充称，这类融资通常结局不佳。
evidence.speaker: Jay Goldberg / Seaport Research

evidence.quote: Shares of Nvidia lost 5% in Monday's trading.
evidence.one_line: Nvidia股价在2026年7月27日周一交易中下跌5%。
evidence.speaker: Hannah Pedone / MarketWatch

evidence.quote: The project is located on a decommissioned uranium-enrichment site, and the campus would require 10 gigawatts of electricity.
evidence.one_line: 报道描述的俄亥俄州项目位于已退役的铀浓缩场址，园区需用电10吉瓦。
evidence.speaker: Hannah Pedone / MarketWatch

evidence.quote: The backing by Nvidia would enable SoftBank to raise debt on more favorable terms - which would otherwise be challenging given how S&P Global has flagged OpenAI as a key credit risk.
evidence.one_line: 报道认为，Nvidia提供担保将使软银能以更有利条件举债；若没有担保，因标普全球将OpenAI列为关键信用风险，融资会更具挑战。
evidence.speaker: Hannah Pedone / MarketWatch

evidence.quote: "Investor feedback late last night was a combination of this being the clearest/largest circular-financing headline we've seen so far and we're not entirely new to this circular-financing debacle," Jefferies technology strategist Jeffrey Favuzza said in a note to clients.
evidence.one_line: Jefferies科技策略师Jeffrey Favuzza在客户报告中称，投资者认为该报道是迄今最明确、规模最大的循环融资头条，但市场并非首次面对循环融资问题。
evidence.speaker: Jeffrey Favuzza / Jefferies

evidence.quote: Nvidia already has committed to investments in OpenAI, and also amended some of the earlier terms of such arrangements.
evidence.one_line: 报道指出，Nvidia已承诺投资OpenAI，并修改过部分早前安排的条款。
evidence.speaker: Hannah Pedone / MarketWatch

evidence.quote: In February, the Financial Times reported that Nvidia was pulling out from a $100 billion agreement originally announced in September, and replacing it with a $30 billion equity investment.
evidence.one_line: 《金融时报》在2026年2月报道称，Nvidia退出了原于2025年9月宣布的1000亿美元协议，并以300亿美元股权投资取代。
evidence.speaker: Hannah Pedone / MarketWatch

evidence.quote: Additionally, OpenAI has committed $300 billion to Oracle (ORCL) to secure data-center capacity, much of which Oracle will use to buy Nvidia GPUs.
evidence.one_line: 报道指出，OpenAI已承诺向甲骨文投入3000亿美元以取得数据中心容量，甲骨文将用其中很大一部分购买Nvidia GPU。
evidence.speaker: Hannah Pedone / MarketWatch
